memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end, and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the other lands, but in the whole land of Egypt there was food." - Gen 41:53-54 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The good years end, and the famine begins — "just as Joseph had said." God's word, spoken through Joseph, comes true down to the detail. And now the wisdom of preparation is proven: while famine grips "all the other lands," Egypt alone has food. Because they listened and prepared during the years of plenty, they are ready when the lean years come.

There is a striking contrast in this verse. Everywhere else, there is famine and want; but in Egypt, there is food. The difference was not that Egypt escaped the famine — the famine came to Egypt too. The difference was that Egypt had prepared. They had heeded God's warning and stored up while they could, and so they had provision when the crisis struck.

This holds a lesson for our lives. Hard times come to everyone; no one is exempt from seasons of "famine." The question is whether we have prepared. Those who build reserves in the good years — who deepen their faith, store up God's Word in their hearts, and cultivate godly habits — will have something to draw on when trials come. Those who did not prepare are caught empty.

Storms come to all houses; the difference is the foundation (Matt 7:24-27). Use your good seasons to build. When the famine comes — and in some form it will — you will be glad you prepared. And even in famine, God is a faithful provider to those who trust Him.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I preparing now for the "famine" seasons that come to all?
2. Have I stored up God's Word and deepened my faith for hard times?
3. Where do I need to build reserves while I still can?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, hard seasons come to everyone. Help me to prepare now — to store up Your Word and deepen my faith — so I am ready when trials come. Thank You that You provide even in famine. Amen.
